answer_1.quote: we design an evaluation framework with tasks relevant to BLV individuals, focusing on five key areas as shown in Figure : 1) Image Captioning targeting cultural content, 2) multilingual Image Question Answering, 3) Optical Braille Recognition to transcribe and answer questions about Braille text rendered in images, 4) Video Object Recognition covering general usage objects as well as assistive items commonly used by BLV people, and 5) Video Question Answering covering descriptive, spatial, and adversarial questions.
answer_1.outputs: Image captions, answers to visual questions, transcriptions of Braille text

answer_2.quote: As a metric, we use the RefCLIPScore , which has shown robust alignment with human judgment.

answer_3.quote: LAVE uses a language model judge to provide a rationale and a rating between 1-3.

answer_4.quote: We also involved four human evaluators to independently evaluate 150 responses from three of our models.
